headline: Staff changes, a new monitor, a dementia class, and a therapy dog event.
summary: A vote and a plan to reorganize the center are on the agenda. Foot traffic is rising, an old art class is returning, and an AARP tax program is coming up.
items: New art class and old art class resuming
Next few meetings, starting Tuesday, September 29th
location: City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, 1st Floor, Boardroom 108, Malden, MA
